mri_label_suggestions.title: MRI Label Suggestion Prompt
mri_label_suggestions.description: Specialized prompt for generating anatomical structure labels in MRI scans
mri_label_suggestions.prompt:
You are an expert radiologist examining an MRI scan. Please analyze this medical image and suggest appropriate anatomical labels for the visible structures. For each structure you identify, provide:

1. Structure name (e.g., 'Gray Matter', 'White Matter', 'Cerebrospinal Fluid')
2. Approximate location or region
3. Confidence level (High/Medium/Low)
4. Clinical significance if relevant

Focus on clearly visible and clinically relevant anatomical structures. If pathological findings are visible, note them separately.

Format your response as a structured list with clear labels and descriptions.

brain_region_analysis.title: Brain Region Analysis
brain_region_analysis.description: Detailed analysis of specific brain regions in MRI
brain_region_analysis.prompt:
As a neuroradiologist, examine this brain MRI slice and provide a detailed analysis of the visible brain regions. Include:

- Primary anatomical structures visible
- Tissue types (gray matter, white matter, CSF)
- Anatomical landmarks
- Symmetry assessment
- Any notable features or variants

Provide precise anatomical terminology and clinical context where appropriate.

pathology_detection.title: Pathology Detection and Description
pathology_detection.description: Identify and describe potential pathological findings
pathology_detection.prompt:
Examine this MRI image as an experienced radiologist looking for pathological findings. Report:

1. Normal anatomical structures present
2. Any abnormal signal intensities or lesions
3. Structural abnormalities or mass effects
4. Vascular changes if visible
5. Overall assessment and recommendations

Use appropriate medical terminology and indicate confidence levels for any findings. If no pathology is evident, state this clearly.

educational_description.title: Educational MRI Description
educational_description.description: Comprehensive educational description suitable for medical students
educational_description.prompt:
Describe this MRI brain slice in detail for medical education purposes. Include:

**Imaging Parameters:**
- Apparent sequence type (T1, T2, FLAIR, etc.)
- Image orientation and plane

**Anatomical Structures:**
- Major brain regions visible
- Tissue contrast and characteristics
- Anatomical landmarks

**Educational Points:**
- Key learning objectives
- Important anatomical relationships
- Clinical correlations

Make this accessible to medical students while maintaining accuracy.

technical_analysis.title: Technical Image Analysis
technical_analysis.description: Technical assessment of MRI image quality and characteristics
technical_analysis.prompt:
Provide a technical analysis of this MRI image focusing on:

**Image Quality:**
- Resolution and clarity
- Artifacts present (if any)
- Contrast quality

**Technical Assessment:**
- Likely sequence parameters
- Tissue contrast characteristics
- Image orientation and positioning

**Recommendations:**
- Suitability for diagnostic purposes
- Suggestions for optimization (if needed)

Focus on technical imaging aspects rather than clinical interpretation.
